EXTRAORDINARY
Annexure No. 01
NORTH CENTRAL PROVINCE
Amendment of Rules published in the Government Extraordinary Gazette No. 2086/15 of dated 29.08.2018

BY virtue of the powers vested in me in the Minister in charge of the subject, under Section 289(1) of Municipal CouncilOrdinance (Chapter 252) that should be read with Section 2 of Provincial Council (Incidental Provisions) Act, No. 12 of1989 and the power vested in me in the Minister in charge of the subject under Subsection 184(1)(c)(e)(f) of PradeshiyaSahba Act, No. 15 of 1987 and in accordance with powers vested in me as the Governor of North Central Province, I dohereby order to amend the rules published in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2086/15 and dated 29.08.2018 and to implementas following :
This Rules shall be effected from 1st of April, 2019.
SARATH EKANAYAKE,Governor of North Central Province,North Central Province.At Governor’s Officeof North Central Province,28th March, 2019.
01. Refreshment Allowances and refreshment expenses for Honourable Mayors and Deputy Mayors of theMunicipal Council :
Present System
3.IMonthly allowance of Rs. 3000.00 can be paid to the Mayor of Municipal Council as refreshmentallowance. The expenditure Head should be submitted for the purpose.

3.IIMonthly allowance of Rs. 750.00 can be paid to the Deputy Mayor of Municipal Council as refreshmentallowance. The Expenditure Head should be submitted for the purpose.
3. IIIFor the Members of Municipal Council participation for meeting of Municipal Council each memberfor each meeting could be spent Rs. 100.00 under Municipal Council Fund.
The System after the revision
3.IMonthly allowance of Rs. 5000.00 can be paid to the Mayor of Municipal Council as refreshmentallowance. The expenditure Head should be submitted for the purpose.
3.IIMonthly allowance of Rs. 3000.00 can be paid to the Deputy Mayor of Municipal Council asrefreshment allowance. The Expenditure Head should be submitted for the purpose.
3. IIIFor the Members of Municipal Council participation for meeting of Municipal Council each memberfor each meeting could be spent Rs. 200.00 under Municipal Council Fund.
02. Refreshment allowances and refereshment expenses for honourable Chairman and members of PradeshiyaSabha
Present System
3.IMonthly allowance of Rs. 2000.00 can be paid to the Chairman of Pradeshiya Sabha as refreshmentallowance. The expenditure Head should be submitted for the purpose.
3. IIFor the Members of Pradeshiya Sabha participation for meeting of Pradeshiya Sabha each memberfor each meeting could be spent Rs. 100.00 under Pradeshiya Sabha Fund.
System after the revision
3.IMonthly allowances of Rs. 4000.00 can be paid to the Chairman of Pradeshiya Sabha as refreshmentallowance. The expenditure Head should be submitted for the purpose.
3. IIFor the Members of Pradeshiya Sabha participation for meeting of Pradeshiya Sabha each memberfor each meeting could be spent Rs. 200.00 under Pradeshiya Sabha Fund.
03. Allowances for Personal Staff of the Chairman of Pradeshiya Sabha
Present System
6.IThe Chairman of the Pradeshiya Sabha could appoint a personal assistant and a maximum amount ofRs. 7500.00 could be paid for him/her under Pradeshiya Sabha Fund.
System after the revision
6.IThe Chairman of the Pradeshiya Sabha could appoint a personal assistant and a maximum amount ofRs. 12,500.00 could be paid for personal assistant under Pradeshiya Sabha Fund.
